author_review.reason: Author review for MetaMask broker/data-source feature parity and OrderStatus.AWAITING_APPROVAL (feat/metamask-broker-completeness merged with dev 4.6.99, Nov 25 2026): lumibot/brokers/metamask.py, lumibot/data_sources/metamask_data.py, lumibot/tools/metamask/{engine,journal,models,venue}.py, and lumibot/tools/metamask_client.py implement MetaMask Agent Wallet perpetual order parity (trigger/bracket/OTO/OCO, ORDER_SUPPORT, sizing/contract spec, L2 quotes, native candles) and AWAITING_MFA -> awaiting_approval lifecycle; lumibot/entities/order.py adds the additive active status OrderStatus.AWAITING_APPROVAL (with aliases pending_approval/awaiting_mfa) without altering any existing status, alias, or equivalence rule; lumibot/brokers/broker.py fixes Decimal * float fractional close_position and lumibot/strategies/{_strategy,strategy}.py default Strategy.quote_asset to USDC for MetaMask perp mode only. The retained option/attention and single-option eval cases run on PandasDataBacktesting and BacktestingBroker, never construct MetaMask or emit awaiting_approval, and no prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper, or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.99 (release captain, Nov 25 2026), bug fixes only.
